title: At the Restaurant
text:
The menu is on the table. It has soup, salad, and fish. Lucas likes the soup, but he does not like fish. He wants a salad.

Maria orders a chicken sandwich and orange juice. The juice is cold and very good. The bill is ten dollars. Lucas and Maria pay and say thank you.

options: A chicken sandwich and orange juice

questions.text: Why does Lucas order a salad?
How do Lucas and Maria probably feel at the end?

vocabulary.definition: a list of food and drinks in a restaurant
a dish of mixed vegetables, often eaten cold
a paper that shows how much money you must pay

paragraph_translations: O cardápio está na mesa. Ele tem sopa, salada e peixe. Lucas gosta da sopa, mas não gosta de peixe. Ele quer uma salada.
Maria pede um sanduíche de frango e suco de laranja. O suco está gelado e muito bom. A conta é de dez dólares. Lucas e Maria pagam e dizem obrigado.
